findings.note: Now 'uncertain', so general/EWS students with an EBC or DNT certificate see 'check with the office' instead of NOT_ELIGIBLE, matching §5(i) ('OBCs, EBCs and DNTs') and the guideline's definition of EBC/DNT students as those not covered under SC, ST or OBC. The fixture 'general category' expects NEED_MORE_INFO. Side effect: SC and ST students also get NEED_MORE_INFO rather than NOT_ELIGIBLE; they have their own schemes.
